messages:
Eli: Quick accessibility/regression note from today's review: VoiceOver is announcing the canary allocation twice when a variant row is collapsed — users hear 'Canary 3%... Canary 3%'. :grimacing:
Noah: Repro on macOS Safari. Looks like both the pill's aria-live and a visible label in the collapsed row are being announced.
Samira: I couldn't repro with NVDA; seems VoiceOver-specific. Could be the collapsed label is visually hidden but not hidden from AT.
Kei: Minimal fix proposal: keep a single sr-only aria-live in the pill and mark the duplicate collapsed label aria-hidden="true". Also set aria-atomic="true" to avoid partial announces.
Eli: Also found a microcopy inconsistency: the action for variants reads "Pause rollout" but product wants to pause only the variant. Recommend switching to "Pause canary" + update the tooltip.
Noah: Good call. And another bug: when you scrub to a past snapshot and hit rollback, the modal shows the current time instead of the snapshot time. That confused QA during demo.
Samira: I'll patch the modal to use selectedSnapshot.timestamp and change the modal header to "Rollback to snapshot vX.Y.Z  2025-11-10 10:45 UTC" and primary CTA to "Rollback to snapshot" (avoid generic "Confirm").
Kei: I'll open a small PR bundling: 1) aria-hidden duplicate label + sr-only live region, 2) copy change to "Pause canary" + tooltip sync, 3) 2px focus ring for tiny pills in high-contrast. Samira will own modal timestamp fix.
AssistBot: Accessibility scan queued: AR-2025-312 duplicate-live-region (severity: medium).
Eli: Please include VoiceOver + NVDA manual test steps in the PR checklist and put changes behind a feature flag. I'll run VoiceOver verification once the flag is on.
__notes: Unique thread: focuses on VoiceOver duplicate announcement, explicit "Pause canary" copy change, rollback modal timestamp bug, small code snippet idea implied, short Slack-style messages. Filename chosen to avoid mirroring existing files.
